summary: Append-only local JSONL log under .agentic/events/ with ULID event_id, per-writer seq (locked JSON + file lock), stable event_key for transition retries (transition_id scrubbed into event_key), secret scrubbing before write, cross-process-safe writer_id (lock + O_EXCL + unlink/retry on empty/truncated crash), and ordered iteration API for repo+issue; integration merge path logs state_transition before GitHub label/close writes.
migration_impact: Repositories may accumulate ignored .agentic/events/ files locally; no template migration required.
agent_notes: Uses state_store.locked_json (#1368) for seq; concurrent appends use dedicated .jsonl.lock. Part of epic #1383.
